name: 2SC1815
description: Classic Toshiba NPN low-noise AF amplifier, ubiquitous in Japanese audio and small-signal designs. TO-92 pinout is E-C-B (the Japanese convention): emitter and base are the outer pins, collector is the center pin. This is a different physical layout from European C-B-E and American E-B-C parts. Complement to the 2SA1015.

pins.name: E
pins.description: emitter (leftmost lead, flat face toward you)

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: E-C-B left to right. Collector is the CENTER pin (Japanese convention), unlike base-center European/American parts. Verified from Toshiba and UTC datasheets (both 1=E, 2=C, 3=B).

typical_application: Low-noise audio-frequency voltage amplifier and driver stage; a default small-signal NPN in vintage and modern Japanese audio circuits.
gotchas: pinout is E-C-B with COLLECTOR in the CENTER, not base; dropping it into a BC547 (C-B-E) or 2N3904 (E-B-C) footprint swaps leads
hFE rank suffix (O/Y/GR/BL) matters a lot: BL (350-700) and O (70-140) behave very differently; sort by suffix for matched pairs
marked 'C1815' on the body with the rank letter; do not read the rank letter as part of the type
